articles.summary: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, July 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Methanex Corporation (the “Company” or “Methanex”) (TSX: MX) (Nasdaq: MEOH) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of US$0.185 per share.
